mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM basecamp_member bm JOIN basecamp b ON b.id = bm.basecamp_id WHERE bm.member_id = #{memberId} AND bm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_companions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companion_review r JOIN basecamp b ON b.id = r.basecamp_id WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{memberId} AND r.hidden_at IS NULL AND (b.completed_at < #{revealCutoff} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companion_review rv WHERE rv.basecamp_id = r.basecamp_id AND rv.reviewer_id = r.reviewee_id AND rv.reviewee_id = r.reviewer_id))) AS received_reviews, (SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN r.rejoin_wanted THEN 1 END) FROM companion_review r JOIN basecamp b ON b.id = r.basecamp_id WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{memberId} AND r.hidden_at IS NULL AND (b.completed_at < #{revealCutoff} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companion_review rv WHERE rv.basecamp_id = r.basecamp_id AND rv.reviewer_id = r.reviewee_id AND rv.reviewee_id = r.reviewer_id))) AS rejoin_wanted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM basecamp_member bm WHERE bm.member_id = #{memberId} AND bm.early_leave = TRUE AND bm.left_at >= #{recentSince}) AS recent_early_leaves, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sanction s WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId} AND s.type <> 'TEMPORARY_72H' AND s.status <> 'LIFTED' AND s.starts_at >= #{recentSince}) AS recent_sanction

SELECT t.tag AS tag, COUNT(*) AS count FROM companion_review r JOIN basecamp b ON b.id = r.basecamp_id JOIN companion_review_tag t ON t.review_id = r.id WHERE r.reviewee_id = #{memberId} AND r.hidden_at IS NULL AND (b.completed_at < #{revealCutoff} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companion_review rv WHERE rv.basecamp_id = r.basecamp_id AND rv.reviewer_id = r.reviewee_id AND rv.reviewee_id = r.reviewer_id)) GROUP BY t.tag
